items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: That's his name. ... He was an arranger, he was an arranger. Horace Diaz.

ctx.x: Yeah, he went to New York. He became, well, he became, he later became the second piano for the famous piano player, the orchestra leader. Oh, shit. Better than Horace Diaz? That's, that's his name.
How did you get that? Well, you described him. Well, you did a good job of describing it. He was an arranger, he was an arranger. Horace Diaz.
